title: Cross-validate: Schnorr48 signature parity
close_reason: Cross-validated Schnorr48 parity across Python (python/src/lichen/crypto/schnorr48.py) and Rust (lichen-link via schnorr48 crate) against canonical corpus test/vectors/schnorr48.json (14 vectors). Both implementations reproduce identical keypairs/signatures from every valid vector and reject all invalid ones. Added rust/lichen-link/tests/schnorr48_vectors.rs (full-corpus JSON-driven sign+verify+determinism, superseding determinism-only integration test); repointed python/tests/crypto/test_schnorr48.py from stale spec/test-vectors copy to canonical corpus and strengthened privkey+repeat-sign checks. Runtime sign-in-Py/verify-in-Rust and reverse cross-check over 8 fresh random inputs PASSED both directions incl. tamper rejection (throwaway CLI, removed after). Gates: pytest crypto 364 passed; cargo test -p lichen-link --features std,schnorr all passed (142 unit + integrations); clippy -D warnings clean; fmt clean for touched file.
